sources.notes: The eCFR versioner XML of 14 CFR part 107 as of 2026-01-01, byte for byte as the faa-part-107 engine commits it at corpus/part107.xml (the commit is pinned in tools/calibration/consumers.json). The engine cites these bytes directly, so the baseline names this source artifact. The xml adapter segments it by its DIV8 elements (one per section, id from the N attribute) into a canonical artifact that is these same bytes. A work of the United States Government, in the public domain. No retrieval date is recorded because the consumer records none.
